description: Extract local business data from Google Maps IN BULK: names, addresses, phones, ratings, review counts, websites, GPS coordinates — up to 100 businesses per call (refine the query for narrower results). Use when you need lead lists, competitor maps or market research across a city or search query — i.e. MANY businesses as raw data, with no scoring or audit. Use local_presence_audit instead when you need a deep scored audit of ONE business (GBP + reviews + website AI-readiness + deliverables); use review_radar instead to detect only NEW reviews on businesses you already track. Returns an array of business objects, everything in one response (no pagination; truncated beyond 100 items). Auth: Apify API token required (Authorization: Bearer). Rate limit: 60 calls/min/IP on this facade. Pricing: $1.00 per run + $0.03 per business scraped.
